summary: A mission run that pins a resource observation this member trimmed now fails with `trimmed-resource-input-version` ("resource/x@id was trimmed on this member; pin a kept observation or the subject") instead of `missing-resource-input-version`, which the reconciler treats as a claim still to arrive and retries

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently.

compatibility.detail: Only the error for a pin of a trimmed or checkpoint-dropped observation changes; a pin of a claim not yet replicated still waits.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the old error code.
